RLVR (Exact Verifier).coverage: Exact outcome-only; zero intermediate reasoning visibility (S_reason = 0.0)
RLVR (Exact Verifier).noise: Zero noise (deterministic string & numerical equivalence checking)
RLVR (Exact Verifier).exploitability: Blind to flawed intermediate derivations and lucky guesses; immune to filler/length bias
RLVR (Exact Verifier).compute_cost: Negligible (sub-millisecond CPU regex extraction; 0 GPU memory/compute)

RLAIF (Pairwise AI Judge).signal_type: Dense relative pairwise win rate in [0, 1]
RLAIF (Pairwise AI Judge).coverage: Evaluates full reasoning chain and coherence; graded relative quality signal
RLAIF (Pairwise AI Judge).noise: Non-zero stochasticity, position bias (mitigated by prompt swapping), and judge ties
RLAIF (Pairwise AI Judge).exploitability: Susceptible to persuasive framing, stylistic filler, and verbosity bias
RLAIF (Pairwise AI Judge).compute_cost: High (requires autoregressive inference with a 3B LLM; substantial GPU memory & latency)
